europe_now.title: France expels two Iranian diplomats amid escalating diplomatic row
europe_now.summary: France has expelled two Iranian diplomats following accusations of interference in domestic affairs and heightened tensions with Tehran. The move reflects ongoing diplomatic friction between Europe and Iran.

sources.headline: France expels 2 Iranian diplomats in escalating row with Tehran

top_stories.title: Meta faces landmark trial over alleged exploitation of children's data
top_stories.summary: A US legal action against Meta has commenced, alleging the company knowingly harmed young users through its platforms. The trial focuses on claims of profit-driven exploitation of children's data.
